title: Outcome-based accreditation framework
description: A framework that defines outcomes a graduate is expected to attain — NBA's programme outcomes, ABET's student outcomes. Criterion-based bodies such as NAAC and NIRF do NOT use this schema; see framework-criteria.schema.json. The distinction is not cosmetic: an outcome is something a student demonstrates and a criterion is something an institution evidences, and conflating them misrepresents at least one of the two.

id.description: Registry path, e.g. nba/gapc-v4.0. Stable and never reused.

programme_scope.description: Which programmes this outcome set applies to. A body may publish several.

supersedes.description: Registry id of the version this replaces. Superseded versions are never removed — historical evidence computed under them must stay reproducible.

source_document.description: Title of the official manual this was transcribed from. Required: an untraceable statement is worse than a missing one, because it will be trusted.

verified_on.description:
Last date a human checked this file, statement by statement, against the official manual at source_url.

Null means nobody has done that yet. Null is a legitimate and expected state for a newly transcribed framework, and it must never be filled in with a plausible-looking date to make a badge go green — the date is the only thing separating this registry from an unattributed copy-paste. When null, `verification_note` is required and the staleness badge reads UNVERIFIED.

The badge uses the OLDEST verified_on across all files, so one freshly-checked file cannot make a neglected one look current.

verification_note.description: Required when verified_on is null: what state the transcription is in, and what specifically a verifier must check.

affects.description: Outcome codes materially changed. Drives the migration workflow's human-decision gate.

require_wk_mapping.description: Whether this framework expects outcomes to be mapped to knowledge indicators as a third dimension alongside programme outcomes.

pso_template.description: Programme-specific outcome placeholders. The framework fixes how many; the institution writes the statements, so these ship with empty statement text.

knowledge_indicators_ref.description: Path to the knowledge-indicator definitions for this framework version, e.g. 'wk-indicators.json'. Definitions live in their own file because a knowledge indicator is a third mapping dimension alongside programme and programme-specific outcomes, not a property of either.

then.description: An unverified file must say so in words, not just by omission.

kind.description: po = programme outcome, pso = programme-specific outcome, so = student outcome (ABET).

statement.description: The official wording. Reproduced VERBATIM in a Self-Assessment Report, so a paraphrase is a defect. May be empty only for a pso_template entry.

knowledge_indicators.description: Knowledge indicator codes the framework associates with this outcome.

migrated_from.description: Predecessor outcome code(s), '+' separated where two collapsed into one. Two codes here means the correspondence is NOT mechanical and needs a human decision.

retired_in.description: Version in which this outcome ceased to exist. Retired outcomes are never deleted from the superseded file.
